senses.nuances: 此处仅暂按专名处理，noun 包含专有名词。不同命名传统或转写方式可能涉及表示胜利的 fatḥ 或表示开拓者、征服者的 fātiḥ，不能自动等同。未获得 DBP 正式词条证据，因此不标 official。以下为称呼结构示例，并非经语料核实的高频搭配。[Fateh 名字及相关形式](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fateh/tree)；[阿拉伯语 fatḥ 的研究](https://www.middleeastmedievalists.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/UW-24.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Fateh illustrates how a name can cross languages without preserving every distinction in its original script. Related naming traditions draw on Arabic words connected with opening and victory, but the Latin spelling alone cannot identify the exact source form. The historical lesson is practical: establish the person's original spelling and pronunciation before assigning a precise etymological meaning. [Related name forms](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fateh/tree)
